# Tropical Champions Parade 2027: Rio and Angra dos Reis

**Dates:** 12–21 February 2027. **Duration:** 10 days / 9 nights.  
**Route:** Rio de Janeiro (3 nights) — Angra dos Reis (6 nights).  
**Format:** group tour with an English-speaking guide on excursions in Rio.

Rio welcomes you with green hills, ocean views and colourful Carnival costumes. During the first few days, you will go up Sugar Loaf, see the historic city centre, attend the Parade of Champions at the Sambadrome and take the train to Christ the Redeemer on Corcovado. The journey then continues to the coast of Angra dos Reis.

You will spend 6 nights in Angra dos Reis, with free time to relax by the sea. Your hotel stay is all inclusive. There are no compulsory additional excursions at the resort.

## Hotels and accommodation

Accommodation in Rio de Janeiro includes breakfast (BB). In Angra dos Reis, you will stay at Vila Galé Angra on an All Inclusive basis, or a similar hotel.

- **4* category:** Windsor Leme (BB) in Rio + Vila Galé Angra (All Inclusive), or hotels of a similar category.
- **5* category:** Miramar by Windsor (BB) in Rio + Vila Galé Angra (All Inclusive), or hotels of a similar category.

Hotels may be replaced by others of the same category.

## Tour price per person

| Category | SGL (single) | DBL (double) | TRP (triple) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 4* | $7,390 | $4,280 | $3,930 |
| 5* | $7,925 | $4,840 | $4,300 |

The price includes Carnival tickets, transfers and excursions in the programme. International flights are paid separately. Dinner at Marius restaurant, should you choose to go, costs $130 per person.

## Carnival and time on the coast

The Parade of Champions brings together Rio de Janeiro's best samba schools. At the Sambadrome, performances feature bands, dancing, elaborate sets and enormous Carnival floats. Your return transfer to the hotel is included.

Then comes Angra dos Reis: quiet bays, green coastal hills, an oceanfront hotel and free days. You can devote these days entirely to relaxation.
